# Pickaxes (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Pickaxes.

# Introduction

Pickaxes is a skill related to Pickaxes weapon class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in pickaxes reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage (against creatures and ores) and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 1.5xp per attack when hitting stone or ore deposits.
